description: This Java source file defines a REST controller for managing Employee entities, providing endpoints for creating, updating, retrieving, listing, and deleting employees. It uses Spring Boot annotations for request mapping, security, and documentation.

classes.name: EmployeeController
classes.description: A REST controller providing endpoints for CRUD operations on Employee entities, secured with role-based access control and documented with Swagger annotations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new employee record; accessible only to users with ADMIN role.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee record by ID; accessible only to users with ADMIN role.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an employee by ID; accessible to users with ADMIN or USER roles.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists all employees; accessible to users with ADMIN or USER roles.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an employee by ID; accessible only to users with ADMIN role.
